Buoyant Tap.name: Buoyant Tap
Buoyant Tap.description: With a rubbery fingertip tap, the user halves the weight of a person or an object up to a scooter's weight and gives their step a gentle spring until a release gesture. A lightened ally bounds across gaps and lands softly from two stories up, while a lightened enemy loses footing and cannot brace for a heavy swing. It needs bare skin contact and reaches half a pure gravity user's load. Strain: light.
